DIAGNOSIS READY: Immune Thrombocytopenia (ITP)

The normal PT, PTT, and clotting factors, combined with the presence of petechiae and mucous membrane bleeding, strongly point to an isolated platelet disorder rather than a coagulation factor deficiency.
